outcomes.label: Real input replacement
outcomes.use_when: Reviewed local source or transcript material is available for this episode.
outcomes.effect: Moves the episode from sample review toward real content while keeping YMM4 and public gates closed.
outcomes.required_next_input: Verified local source/transcript material with provenance.

outcomes.label: YMM4 import observation without render
outcomes.use_when: A human explicitly chooses to inspect import behavior now.
outcomes.effect: Allows a manual import observation only; it does not render, publish, or create a production project claim.
outcomes.required_next_input: Explicit human decision to perform the YMM4 observation outside this prototype.

outcomes.label: Hold and review later
outcomes.use_when: No reviewed local real material is available and no import observation has been selected.
outcomes.effect: Keeps the current sample-backed review as a local record without crossing any production gate.
